content: Dune whunihne, Majine hubuwhútnine, 'enne Jerusalem ts'e hoozdil

'Et 'awet yun k'ut Judea, keyoh Bethlehem whuz'ai-un, 'et Sizi whuzdli. 'Oh da' whuz un'a Herod lerwe unli whe 'et 'uhooja. 'Et 'awet whuzdli hukw'elh'az khunsul nda' whut'enne keyoh Jerusalem ts'e hoozdil. 'Enne whunihne Majine hubuhútnine, 'enne 'uhint'oh.

'Ink'ez dune hoodulhkut, “Lizwifne bulerwe 'andit whuzdli-un, 'en nts'e whuzdli? 'Et ndi sum cho ts'an'en, 'i gha lhuts'úzdil. 'Et huwa ndaz de ndun ts'oodun 'en oots'un teni' ts'untilhdzilh ha whusats'ándilh.”
'Et hoonts'i lerwe Herod whulh udants'o whe ooba dzoh 'uhutni. Jerusalem whut'enne, 'enne cha whuz un'a za buba dzoh 'uhutni.
'Ink'ez ts'iyanne ba lubret bumoodihne 'ink'ez Moses be 'udustl'us 'uk'ununáguzne cha, 'enne ts'iyawh Herod 'anih ubudani'. 'Et 'enne buts'un nahootá'alh Christ ndet whutileh.
'Ink'ez huyulhni, “Yun k'ut Judea, keyoh Bethlehem whuz'ai-un, 'et whutileh. Ndet la nus hoo'en-un 'et 'uk'ehónguz-un, 'et whuz un'a nja dutni,

content.text: ‘Yun k'ut Judea ts'e keyoh Bethlehem whut'enne,
'Alha nohkeyoh 'et whuts'un 'ilhoghun moodih ncha-un, 'et whusatiyalh. 'Ink'ez sdune'ne,

content: 'Et Herod whu'iz whe ndunne whunihne 'anih ubudáni'. 'Enne buts'un nahootá'alh ha 'et soo ndet dzin nts'oya hoozulh whe ndi sum be hóodiltsai.

'Et hukw'elh'az keyoh Bethlehem ts'e whebalh'a' 'ink'ez ndúbulhni, “Ahdulh 'ink'ez howa 'óohli whe ts'oodun nalhtih. 'Et nawhah'ai de, nts'e 'unt'oh 'et sts'ótl'a khuni ooh'alh. Si cha whuz tisyalh oots'u teni' ntisdzilh ha.”

'Et lerwe 'et ndúbulhni whe 'aho whehándil. 'oh whuya hidulh whe khunsul ndai la ndi sum ndaz ts'e hinalh'en-i, 'i hitilh'en 'ink'ez 'ants'i butso ults'ulh. 'Et nts'e la ts'oodun usda-un 'on do, 'et lhghá nelts'ut.
'Et ndet la sum hinalh'en da' 'uk'enus huhóont'i' k'et 'aw 'uhoot'e' ait'oh.

'Et 'ink'ez yoh dahunindil whe ndun ts'oodun hitilh'en. Ooloo Mary 'en cha 'et usda. Hibut nachánilya 'ink'ez hits'un teni' nalhdzun. Unzoo-i huye 'úzdla-i hidah lhch'az hiyilhchoot whe ndai la unzoo-i hiyé hahúyanla 'ink'ez hits'u hítilhdil. Gold, yoo sooltsun-i frankencense huyulhni, 'ink'ez yoo Myrrh huyulhni cha, 'i ts'iyawh hits'u hítilhdil.
'Ink'ez Yak'usda bubul be bugha dáni' 'et 'aw Herod 'en ookw'unaoohdilh junih budáni' 'Et huwa 'uts'o whuya dukeyoh ts'e whenáhidilh.
Joseph, Mary te, 'ink'ez Sizi bulh yun k'ut Egypt ts'uwhútni, whuz whehándil

'Et 'awet whunáhidil hukw'elh'az neMoodihti oolizas Joseph nute whe benghun whe hóodiltsai. 'Et 'uyulhni, “Dudinyaih, ndun ts'oodun ooloo bulh ubilhchoot 'ink'ez yun k'ut Egypt 'a cho whuz ubalhtelh! 'Et nohdutásnelh 'et whuts'un 'et dólhts'i'! 'Et 'awet 'áho Herod ts'oodun yuka it'á'elh yutuzilhghelh ha!”
'Inka 'ulhdzis dunadija 'ink'ez ts'oodun ooloo bulh ubilhchoot 'ink'ez yun k'ut Egypt ts'outni whuz whehándil.

'Et Herod datitsah whuts'un 'et 'udutálts'ilh. 'Et ndúhut'en whe neMoodihti nyoon nus hoo'en-un, 'en be daja ni la 'et whunilhchoh 'oh tune' whust'en whe nja dutni, “Sye' 'anih dasni' yun k'ut Egypt whuch'a naooja' ha.”
Lerwe Herod lhuganne ubulhni, “Keyoh Bethlehem ts'e duneyaz nat yus k'ut be suli'ne, 'enne ts'iyawh huboohghan”

'Et 'awet Herod t'eoonanzin ndunne whunihne, Majine huyulhni, nahinan'a, 'et huwa tube hunilch'e. 'Inka nts'oya hoozulh Majine hidáni' whe whulohne lhuganne keyoh Bethlehem ts'e whebalh'a'. 'Et 'ubulhni, 'et keyoh whut'enne ts'iyawh 'ink'ez whunat whut'enne cha mbene la duneyaz nat yus k'ut be suli'ne 'ink'ez whuts'un whudilhdzulhne cha, 'enne ts'iyawh huboohghan.
'Et whuz un'a nyoon nus hoo'en-un Jeremiah huyulhni, daja ni la 'et ts'iyawh whunilhchoh 'oh tune' whust'en whe nja dutni,

content.text: “'Et keyoh Ramah buyiz dahts'o da' tso yahalhduk

content: Joseph, Mary, Sizi cha, keyoh Nazareth huwhútni hudutálts'ilh
'Awet Herod dazsai whe' hoont'oh. 'Et 'awet Egypt yun k'ut ts'e neMoodihti oolizas Joseph huwunute whe benghun néwhults'ut.
'Et ndúyulhni, “Dudinyaih! Ts'oodun duloo bulh nabilhchoot. Israel yun k'ut whuz nahdulh. 'Et whutso da' mbene la ts'oodun yukúniztaine hituzilhghelh ha, ts'iyawh yahadla.”
'Inka dudinya. Ts'oodun duloo bulh nabílhchoot 'ink'ez Israel yun k'ut ts'e whenáhidil.

'Et hoonts'i Joseph whulh udants'o Herod ooye' Archelaus huyulhni, 'en dubá k'edanya 'ink'ez 'andit Judea yun k'ut whulerwe unli. 'Et whuz tiyalh whe nuljut whe howu nusúti 'et Yak'usda yugha dáni'. 'Et huwa Galilee yun k'ut ts'e whuz whehándil.
Whuz hoozdil whe keyoh Nazareth huwhútni, 'et hudutálts'ilh. 'Et whuz un'a nus hoo'enne daja hutni la, 'oh túne'whust'en whe nja duhútni, “'En Nazareth whut'en-un hidutánelh.”
